# text/compose

A built-in compose adapter for records of any type: it needs the step's `uses:` fields and declares no fields of its own. It publishes no per-record estimate, so plan prints `?`, and it demands no credential.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `text/compose` |
| version | 1 |
| role | compose |
| entity type | any type |
| credentials | none |
| cost estimate per record | not published |

## Needs

The fields the step's `uses:` line names, and nothing else.

## Provides

The fields the step's `provides:` line declares.

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `of` | string |  | The referent (ADR-048): the field whose value this step is about. Injected by the runner from the step-level of: key — never authored inside with:. |
| `provides` | object |  | The step's derived provides schema (ADR-033): exactly one field, the rendered text. Injected by the runner from the step-level provides: key — never authored inside with:. |
| `template` | string | yes | The template rendered once per record over record.* (the uses:/of: fields) and config.* (ADR-057); the result is the one field provides: declares. The runner loads {file:} before validation. |

## Example

From [A pipeline is a YAML file](/concepts/pipeline):

```yaml
- id: subject
  use: text/compose
  uses: [full_name, company_name]
  provides: [subject]
  with:
    template: "{{ record.full_name }}, a note for {{ record.company_name }}"
```
